verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party Python SDK. A community comment says TypeScript and Python are both supported, so DBOS offers more than one authoring language. Nothing documents Go or other languages, and nothing shows feature parity across SDKs; the first-party docs cited are all Python-specific. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of TypeScript, Go, or other SDKs, evidence of feature parity across SDKs, and independent corroboration of multi-language usage.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I author workflows in the language my team already uses — TypeScript, Python, Go, or more — with real feature parity across SDKs

citations.quote: Languages that are supported: Typescript and Python.
I built a small side thing using DBOS (using python SDK) and the ergonomics were pretty nice.
